description:
The four Sales By Representative downloads should have fixed, predictable file names. Each one instead has the chosen date range added to the end — sales-by-representative-summary-this_month.csv rather than sales-by-representative-summary.csv — and the added word changes with the range.

All four behave the same way: both spreadsheets and both PDFs.
env: Environment: QA branch sv8582 (https://sv8582.qa.shopview.com), build v3.5-7168d14. Desktop browser, signed in as an Admin.
steps: Open Reports, then Sales By Representative, with the date range on This Month.
Take all four downloads from the three-dot menu and note the file name of each.

Change the date range and take them again, twice, so three different ranges have been tried. The named test data: sales representatives ZZAUTOTEST RepA (one invoice, S-16244) and ZZAUTOTEST RepB (three invoices, S-16243, S-16242, S-16241), plus Parth Fadadu (one invoice, S-15826); customers Aaborough Works, Aacastle Services, Aachester Partners, Aacrest Works and Beman Systems; both locations, Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
current:
Every name carries the range on the end, and the added word changes with it — this_month, this_year, last_week, custom. The same view downloaded three times with three different ranges gave three different names, so the changing part is definitely the date range. The file contents were correct every time.

It defeats the point of a fixed name: anything that picks the file up automatically, or any saved-file rule, will not find it.
expected: The four names are exactly sales-by-representative-summary.pdf, sales-by-representative-expanded.pdf, sales-by-representative-summary.csv and sales-by-representative-expanded.csv.
source: PDF filenames are deterministic: sales-by-representative-summary.pdf and sales-by-representative-expanded.pdf.

The two spreadsheet names are fixed in the same way by requirements S14-R15 and S14-R16, which name the files "sales-by-representative-summary.csv" and "sales-by-representative-expanded.csv" with no range in either.
